hook: Nalgonda e-buses stopped *3 hours* as drivers protest wages
hook_b: Your city bus is running. How is the service where you live?
tldr: Electric bus services at Nalgonda depot were disrupted for three hours on Saturday as drivers protested over wages and alleged harassment.

beats.what: Nalgonda depot e-bus drivers stopped work for three hours on Saturday over wages and alleged harassment.
beats.why: The manpower agency assured them their concerns would be addressed and agreed to meet on November 4.
beats.care: Commuters in Nalgonda lost service for 3 hours. Check with the depot before long trips.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today reports services were disrupted for three hours on Saturday. The manpower agency agreed to meet drivers on Nov 4.

cards.q: How good is the bus service where you live?

learn.t: Many e-bus drivers are hired through manpower agencies, not directly by the transport corporation.

watch: Nov 4 meeting between drivers and the agency.
